description: Ordered build recipes per domain (gameplay ability, open world, locomotion, montage, retarget, motion matching, material, Niagara, UI, data, streaming, packaging, C++ class, MetaHuman, PVE tree...). Each step names the exact Axivor tool to call and the read-back that verifies it, so multi-step builds are decomposed consistently instead of improvised.
catalog_blurb: Step-by-step recipes with verification per domain.
